framework: MLPerf Storage v2.0 reference (storage.git tag v2.0)

description: This implementation uses the MLCommons Storage v2.0 reference code with Curvine v0.2.0 (commit 77320b86) mounted through the Curvine FUSE 3 client; OpenDAL-S3 is used as the underlying file system.
